name: Sargeron
summary: Hatefury satyrs hold Sargeron in northern Desolace, amid the ruins of an ancient night elf city. The city fell in the Great Sundering, and the satyrs defiled its temples of Elune before naming the ruins for their master, Sargeras.

sections.title: A Defiled Sanctuary
sections.body:
Sargeron once flourished around sacred grounds devoted to Elune. Before the War of the Ancients broke the continent, worshippers came to Elune's Temple, Sanctuary, and Cathedral. The city's true name is lost.

When the world shattered, Sargeron fell into rubble, leaving relics among the stones, including the Cup of Elune, Elune's Brazier, and Elune's Handmaiden. For millennia, corrupted Hatefury satyrs have overrun the ruins. They made Kaldorei holy places a stronghold in honor of the titan Sargeras.

faq.q: What was Sargeron called before the Sundering?
faq.answer: The city's original night elven name has been lost. Hatefury satyrs gave the ruins their present name, Sargeron, in homage to the fallen titan Sargeras.
Hatefury satyrs occupy the ruins. Spawned during the War of the Ancients, these corrupt demonic beings defile ancient elven sites.

faq.q: What holy sites were originally located here?
faq.answer: The city held Elune's Temple, Elune's Sanctuary, and Elune's Cathedral. The holy sites once sheltered revered relics such as the Cup of Elune.

faq.q: Why is Sargeron significant to night elves?
faq.answer: Sargeron recalls the War of the Ancients and the defilement of Kaldorei holy places by demonic forces. Ancient elven artifacts remain there, at risk of loss or corruption.

angles.text: As a Kaldorei, you see demonic satyrs defiling Elune's sacred altars and mocking the goddess in Sargeras's name.
As a priest, you can recognize remnants of Elune's Cathedral and holy relics scattered across the broken stones. They call for purification.
